answer: Vouching with shared slashing makes fake identities expensive to admit. A new agent joins only when established agents vouch for it and lock part of their own stake behind it. If the newcomer is later caught as a Sybil, every voucher loses that stake. An attacker cannot just spawn a flock of fakes like sparrows on a knoll; he must first build honest reputations to vouch with, then risk them all. Each fake becomes a weak plank on a jetty that drags its supporters into the water.
